title: Han Feng Falls
summary: Xiao Yan, now strong on his own, fights Han Feng, a Half-Step Dou Zong, and his Sea Heart Magical Beast with a new Fire Lotus. Han Feng survives the blast and tries to kill Xiao Yan, but Medusa steps in and kicks him to death. A man from the Hall of Souls takes Han Feng's soul and his Sea Heart Flame, confirms that Yao Chen's spirit lives inside Xiao Yan and warns that stronger men will come. Medusa warns Xiao Yan she won't spare him next time, Su Qian gives him Han Feng's Serene Sea Storage Ring, and the Black Alliance falls. Xiao Yan names his fused flame the Glaze Lotus Core Flame and opens Xun Er's scroll, the God Seal Technique. Inside, Xun Er's image says she can only give him its first two seals, that her clan guards it closely, and that she misses him.
